rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality early/degenerative blastocyst with absent/unclear ICM and sparse TE, consistent with 0DD; minor overinterpretation of debris/collapse and limited comment on zona.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve/response, BMI, male factor, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately driven by very poor morphology and adverse history; slight overreach in attributing embryo issues to sperm DNA fragmentation without direct evidence.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including single embryo transfer, luteal support, uterine evaluation, and consideration of PGT-A after repeated failure; a few suggestions are more discretionary than guideline-mandated.
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including counseling, transfer approach, workup priorities, and embryo/sperm strategy review.
